Verify you’re human on your phone

For the first time, you can be rewarded for being human, without having to hand over sensitive biometric data to any third-party service provider, using hardware scattered across the world.

Simply verify your human likeness using the ImHuman app that transforms your biometric data into encrypted vectors right on your device. These vectors are securely encrypted using your client key and sent to our Privasea network's fortified servers.

This process ensure that your original data remains confidential, even from us.
